svg.title: The command /fix
svg.desc: A person comments /fix on a pull request. Only someone with write access starts the bot, and anybody else gets that answer. The bot waits for the checks of the head that keep fixes and takes their fixes as data; while one still runs, it commits nothing and asks for the command again later. A branch of the repository gets the commit. A fork whose author allows no edits by maintainers gets the suggestions at their lines. On a fork that allows them, the bot commits the files that the pull request changes, and none that decides what a workflow runs. When GitHub refuses that commit, the fork gets the suggestions instead. One comment answers each command with what the bot did.
